title: CoinGecko /simple/price upstream response
description: Response shape from CoinGecko's GET /simple/price?ids=<id>&vs_currencies=usd&include_last_updated_at=true (see ADR-0005). Validated in apps/web's price route before being remapped into price-snapshot.schema.json's shape -- never returned to clients as-is (CoinGecko's terms forbid redistributing the raw payload).

usd_24h_change.description: Signed 24h percent change, from include_24hr_change=true. Real upstream data -- the only way to feed PriceCell's change row without inventing a number.

last_updated_at.description: Unix epoch seconds of the upstream price tick.
